summary_en: On April 30, 2026 (UTC), Wasabi Protocol experienced a security incident. Attackers exploited an analytics surface (Spring Boot Actuator heap dump) on the project’s AWS infrastructure, which leaked credentials and ultimately allowed them to obtain the private keys controlling the EVM smart contracts

sources.title: Wasabi Perps — Key Compromise (Deployer Key Compromised)
